scanCoverage.coverageLimitations: No single public source exposes one fully auditable senior-men domestic feed for every configured association. The rescan therefore used multiple broad boards and deep-audited the strongest candidates. Source-board totals overlap and must not be added together.

modelHealth.finding: The current 35% away-score ceiling produced zero qualifiers in the reconstructable 30-day sample, so no historical hit-rate claim is published for v1.9.
modelHealth.action: Fresh v1.9 candidates require complete current evidence; threshold tuning must be validated on a larger out-of-sample dataset before changing the model.
